retriever: local lexical FTS5 proxy (same tokenizer/rank function in both arms)

cooling.method: remove dual-model-adjudicated no-reusable-value pages from the full-text index only; summaries and page files retained for exact-ID reads

gate_rules_frozen_before_run.works: answer top-1 and top-3 do not decrease; trap-in-top-3 does not increase
gate_rules_frozen_before_run.does_not_work: any gold leaves top-1/top-3 or trap-in-top-3 rises
gate_rules_frozen_before_run.inconclusive: arms non-comparable due to retriever differences

scores.consistency: metrics identical across arms on the development split, the frozen-regression split, and the single affected workspace considered alone

behavior_arm.reason: historical-trial trace shows no wrong-adoption event associated with the demoted pages; a relative-reduction bar is unmeetable at this small scale and the run would be an avoidable spend
behavior_arm.prerequisite_for_future: run value adjudication over a much larger page set; requires separate scale and budget approval

limitations: demoted labels inherited from an earlier independent dual-model review, not re-adjudicated
lexical proxy cannot reproduce production semantic ranking; same-machine arm contrast only
validates the cooling projection method, not the large-scale hot-tier reduction target
no production memory or product code changed
